mapper.select: SELECT t.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_terms_agreements a WHERE a.terms_id = t.id) AS agreement_count FROM terms t ORDER BY t.type ASC, t.version DESC
SELECT t.* FROM terms t WHERE t.is_current = TRUE ORDER BY t.type ASC
SELECT t.* FROM terms t WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM terms WHERE type = #{type}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO terms (type, version, title, content, is_current) VALUES (#{type}, #{version}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isCurrent})
mapper.update: UPDATE terms SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE terms SET is_current = FALSE, updated_at = NOW() WHERE type = #{type}
UPDATE terms SET is_current = TRUE, published_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
